feed.title: @ziyarago/ui changelog
feed.subtitle: Release notes for the ZiyaraGo UI library

entry.content:
### Features
* accessibility audit with axe (0 violations), keyboard navigation for tabs, selects and menus, readable tooltips

### Features
* free Core and Pro split (102 free, 106 Pro): tiers metadata, Pro badges in docs, pricing copy

### Features
* Localization docs page, i18n tests, Pro language pack moved to private repo

### Features
* page templates wave 4 (itinerary, prayer, group manager, public tour), QiblaCompass, bundled fonts, auth page and compat fixes

### Features
* page templates wave 3 (article, changelog, help, states, legal, locations, booking flow)

### Features
* page templates wave 2 (calendar, kanban, billing, team, integrations, search)

### Features
* page templates wave 1 (landing, onboarding, checkout, inbox, notifications, analytics)

### Bug Fixes
* stop shipping 3D icons and brand files, watermark demo icons on the docs site

### Features
* SocialAuth component with Google and Apple buttons

### Features
* AuthShowcase login layouts (photo, light, tint) and PageAuth variants

### Features
* per-component translations (en, ar, ru free; 13 more languages in Pro pack), screenshots in README

### Features
* animated aurora background, kit-owned i18n core, glass-ui-kit compat layer, new landing

### Features
* pricing page with early access list and MCP registry metadata

### Bug Fixes
* **mcp:** add repository metadata required for npm provenance

### Features
* publish @ziyarago/ui and @ziyarago/ui-mcp to npm
# Changelog
All notable changes follow Keep a Changelog and SemVer. Pre-1.0: minor versions may break.

entry.title: 0.1.0 — first release
entry.content:
### Added - Docs site SEO: canonical, Open Graph, Twitter and JSON-LD tags per page, generated `sitemap.xml` and `robots.txt`, 404 page with noindex, og.png, favicon; Google Analytics 4 and Yandex Metrika loaded from build variables. - Deployment of the docs to your own server over SSH (releases directory, atomic switch, rollback): `deploy/`, `.github/workflows/deploy-docs.yml`, `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md`. - Display settings: `useUiTheme()` gains `setMotion('auto|on|off')`, `setEffects('auto|full|lite')` and `setBackground(name)`; attributes `data-motion`, `data-fx`, `data-bg`; no-flash init script in the Nuxt module. - Page backgrounds (`aurora`, `sunset`, `ocean`, `emerald`, `rose`, `mesh`) and gradient cards (`<UiCard variant="gradient" tone intensity>`; 8 tones, soft and vivid, dark and light). - API metadata for all 182 components in `src/meta/` (props with every value, defaults, slots, events), validated against the render code by `npm run check`; shown as API reference tables in the docs. - AI tooling: `dist/manifest.json`, `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt` and the `@ziyarago/ui-mcp` package (MCP server + `init` for AGENTS.md, Claude skill, Cursor rule). - Automated releases: GitHub Actions + semantic-release (version from commit messages), npm publish with provenance and docs deploy to ziyara.vip. See CONTRIBUTING.md. - Page templates gallery in the docs site (`/docs/templates`): 17 live templates in the app shell with top or side menu, slot highlighting and an inspector (accepted components, props, example) for 89 page slots and 5 shell slots. - `size` prop (`xs | sm | md | lg | xl`, default `md`) on controls and density-bearing components (about 120). Adapters set `data-size` on the root; `md` keeps the previous look. Scale tokens `--zg-sz-*` live in `tokens.css`, per-group overrides in `src/styles/sizes/`. - Popup surfaces (`--zg-pop`), stacking tokens (`--zg-z-bar`, `--zg-z-pop`, `--zg-z-modal`) and entrance motion for selects, calendars, menus, hover cards, modals and drawers. - Docs pages for Fonts and Colors (families, tokens, weight mapping, swatches in both themes and both palettes). - Documentation site in `site/` (Nuxt): landing, getting started, theming, 182 component pages with live previews and Vue/React code. - gluestack parity, 16 components: Heading, Text, Box, Center, HStack, VStack, Grid, Link, Pressable, Icon, Portal, LiquidGlass, BottomSheet, Actionsheet, ImageViewer, ChatAi. - Nuxt module `@ziyarago/ui/nuxt` (auto-registered components, CSS, theme attributes, SSR). - Framework-neutral core with Vue 3 (`@ziyarago/ui/vue`) and React 18+ (`@ziyarago/ui/react`) adapters. - 160+ components in 12 groups: actions, forms, surfaces, data, navigation, layout, CRM, hotels, tours and 360°, prayer and Ramadan. - 16 page templates with named slots (`PageDashboard`, `PageCrm`, `PageBookings`, `PageCatalog`, `PageDetail`, `PageSettings`, `PageUserList`, `PageProfile`, `PageForm`, `PageOrder`, `PageAccount`, `PagePricing`, `PageFaq`, `PagePatterns`, `PageAuth`, `PageStatus`). - Two menus in one shell: top and side, with a collapsible sidebar. - OKLCH tokens, palettes `gold` and `tamam`, dark and light themes, RTL, Thmanyah and Manrope. - Validation rules (`rules`) and `ValidatedField`. - `UiMap`, `UiTour` with spotlight, `UiSortable`, `UiTreeSelect`, `UiRichEditor`. - `tokens/tokens.json` for Flutter and native clients; `dist/style.css` single-file stylesheet.
### Known gaps - Props are typed for 9 core components; the rest accept `Record<string, any>`. - Installed from the packed tarball into clean Vite+Vue, Vite+React and Nuxt 3 apps: all build, Nuxt SSR renders. No automated tests yet. - Light theme and RTL are covered by tokens but not yet screenshot-tested for every component.
### Fixed before release - Arabic looked bold: Thmanyah has no 600 face and is heavier than Manrope. `fonts.css` now maps weights with ranges (200-300 Light, 400-600 Regular, 700 Medium, 800 Bold, 900 Black). - Light theme: stronger card separation (`--zg-s1/s2/s3`, `--zg-stroke`, `--zg-rim`, `--zg-shadow-1`); `UiCard variant="inverse"` re-scopes tokens to dark so content inside stays readable; bell counter and incoming-call button text contrast. - `Page*` templates with `title` crashed in Vue/React (`C.PageHeader` was called as a function). - `useUiTheme()` and `UiMap` touched `document` during SSR.
